sentences: Since mid points right at the target already, the loop just needs one more step to find it.
When a[mid] is less than target, low becomes mid so the window still includes index 1.
The code checks a[mid] first, so the next iteration will compare the same middle again.
Because low and high are only 0 and 1, the next mid calculation lands on the target.
After setting low to mid, the loop continues and the target stays inside the search range.
